channel.title: TujuRegEle Luraro Jula
channel.description: WAG ge g winagulogen ninelogowi. Tat jode diw WAG tid tatiriwan leguw. Bada g nojigu luri ge lan renibol jalaneguni tid lanar tat ladigoge le WAG be jinir jodudoburu.

item.title: WAG Telinigod diw Titituruned
item.description:
TujuRegEle lonad Tujaduwaru'w bugutinijaj nitu rodaritew. Jud dobi rodaritew tade tat ridili weloderu na jiguri.

WAG jula jode jutewut:
Leguw Weloderu
Dowowurewulug
Weredini le Jiguri

item.title: WAG Telinigod diw Jutanow ril Botoranu
item.description:

Garuwata Gedogoguwun
Litode Luranogajoluj
Weredini le Jiguri
Gobawe Jotidi
Nenad/Jagitagarodo Godolilo
Dudutew Doweb

item.title: WAG Telinigod diw Gibaguge Wejidun Bulibebar
item.description:

item.title: WAG Telinigod diw Ritinenadaj
item.description:
TujuRegEle lonad Ritinenadaj bugutinijaj nitu tat binebub lugewu gilel tonugajot be renibol natugo, ril jodo tat wagibebaj gader le diguniw be jawelidil tawoliroter natugo.

WAG jode Jutewut:
Tawoliroter Weredini
Jelit
Nodudigad

item.title: WAG Telinigod diw Tawudarotej
item.description:

item.title: WAG Telinigod diw Winojilenoruje
item.description:
TujuRegEle lonad Winojilenoruje bugutinijaj nitu tat binebub lugewu gilel biwit durubona ril noniwuw lodigu, be tajulene runujon. Lanar WAG winojilenoruje tid jode od wawowog birerawidej wewoge ril tina bebadowadad noniwuw durubona.

Jode Jutewut:
Noniwuw Lodigu
Doladato Jewedi
Litode Luranogajoluj

item.title: WAG Telinigod diw Bunudibo & Giwi Tujura Nowoj
item.description:
TujuRegEle lonad Bunudibo ril Giwi Tujura bulibebar bugutinijaj nitu ragaral tajaganaj deru le tuden debitewol rebolalito, ril tudu gigod diwanunajaten. WAG lonad od bebid g gegujiru tejanodi ril wawota tat ruti be ni labojitijen, ronetubegeru derutu.

Gudaw beg wa goda diw:
Tudu Gigod Lobuj
Lod Rebolalito Diw Wiro
Loletige Leboj

item.title: WAG Telinigod diw Tuted / Loletige Bulibebar

Jode jutewut:
Loletige Leboj
Wubijuj Dorebiju Leboj
Lanu Leboj
Weloderu

item.title: WAG Telinigod diw Leb Lojonegagog
item.description:
TujuRegEle lonad Leb Lojonegagog Tuwanaralojud bugutinijaj nitu tat binebub lugewu ril neneb latugela be g lelalo ril nanuninaj derutu. Lanar WAG jibego tid jode od wawowog birerawidej wewoge ril tina bebadowadad julajolaguj.

Jode jutewut:
Robot Lodigu
Gir Togodolo Wagibebaj Radonarojuwe
Noniwuw Lodigu

Tirijidu Lodigu

Godolilo
